messages:
lina: Hey team — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821. Changes: KMS rotation API + audit-log enrichment for key usage. This touches secrets rotation, KMS policy, and a tiny infra TF change. Need security + infra approval before merging; blocks Dedicated release tomorrow. @alex @maria @sam can you take a look? :lock:

alex: looking now. quick q — are we rotating the master key id or adding a rotation policy resource? can you add a short migration note in the PR body?

lina: good call — we added a `rotation_policy` resource and kept the existing alias. added a "migrations" section to the PR with steps to run `scripts/kms/rotate.sh` (idempotent).

deploy-bot: terraform plan finished (tfplan-2026-03-16). Summary:
```
+ aws_kms_key.rotation_policy (new)
~ aws_kms_alias.current (updated)
```
No unexpected drifts.

sam: plan looks fine to me, but HSM team needs to confirm wrap/unwrap permissions for the new policy. pinging @maria for HSM check :eyes:

maria: reading through. two small test nits — mocks for KMS errors and an integration test tweak for audit fields. I'll leave inline comments. HSM wrap/unwrap calls look OK against the emulator, will run a quick on-prem smoke after fixes.

lina: thanks — I pushed a tiny test fix commit and added a note about the smoke test. happy to pair for the on-prem run in 30m if you want.

alex: added `SEC-REVIEWED` label. leaving final LGTM pending the test change. if maria approves, this can merge during the 2pm-4pm release window today :rocket:

maria: tests fixed, ran smoke against staging HSM, everything green. approving now.

alex: approved. please add `SEC-APPROVED` tag and merge when ready.

lina: done — tag added and merging to main. thanks everyone for quick reviews! :tada:
